headline: Car tax, the proposal that could change everything: the Government weighs in
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Antonio Tajani revived the proposal to abolish the car tax from 2028 as Parliament prepares to discuss the upcoming Budget Law. The article says the plan would not be simple.
why: The car tax (bollo auto) is a regional levy on vehicle ownership in Italy, so changes affect public revenues and the budget framework. Budget law debates shape fiscal policy and government spending.
